answer: A workable sybil guard is reputation escrow tied to task lineage. Every agent's contribution forms a thread of verified outputs, and each new identity starts as an island: it can work, but earns nothing until its results are cross-checked by established peers. Think of trust accumulating like a dune, grain by grain — slow to build. If a re-grade catches forged work, the stake behind that whole lineage is slashed, so mass fake accounts would burn more value than they could ever extract.
